Title: Add the canonical ride lifecycle adapter
Problem / Request: Bake service-neutral lifecycle patterns into adapters around the current request, trip, queue, and rider-status systems without replacing current writers or wording.
Acceptance Criteria: Canonical transitions, no skipped pickup/drop-off, idempotent events and queue promotion, existing writers remain authoritative, deterministic no-write tests, no third-party SDK or production deployment.
Integration Hooks: Adapter and test patterns only; feature flag defaults OFF.
